parsed.rationale: Both members are unnamed extensions (kind: 'extension', name: '') on what the cluster identifies as 'NotificationCenter', living in the same package ('Core') under the same directory ('Shared/Core/Sources/Core/Observation/'). Having two separate files each contributing an extension on the same Foundation type within the same package creates fragmented, hard-to-discover surface area. Consolidating them into a single file — e.g., 'Shared/Core/Sources/Core/Observation/NotificationCenter+Core.swift' — would centralise all Core-layer NotificationCenter behaviour without any cross-package or restraint concerns, since all context flags are false for both records. No structural-evidence metrics (Jaccard, shared fields) were available, so the recommendation is scoped conservatively to consolidation rather than deduplication.
